name: Detritus and carrion
description: Dead organic matter and the microbes living on it, in the water and sediments. Functional group pooling five source compartments: living particulate organic carbon, living sediment organic matter (both microbe-rich detrital pools), refractory detritus, labile detritus, and vertebrate carrion, aggregated because all are consumed as non-living food. Because carrion is pooled here, vulture scavenging appears as detritus feeding.
